verdict.rationale: PayPal is a payments platform, not an AI agent or MCP host, so being an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product role. The evidence shows only the opposite role: PayPal publishes its own MCP server (local and remote) and an agent toolkit that exposes PayPal APIs to external agent frameworks. Nothing shows PayPal itself plugging in third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
